summary: Use OpenAI or a compatible server as the AI backend. Requires the AI Core addon and, for most servers, an API key.
description: Connects the AI Core Agent and the other AI addons to any server that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API: OpenAI itself, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama, LM Studio or llama-server. Set the server URL and, where needed, an API key. Prompts and any file contents the Agent sends go to that server.
